description: This file is a Perl script designed to scan man page files related to curl and detect formatting issues, broken references, and other common mistakes. It processes specific sections such as SYNOPSIS, EXAMPLE, and SEE ALSO, and verifies references and formatting correctness.

methods.name: allsymbols
methods.description: Reads a symbols version file and populates the %symbol and %deprecated hashes with symbol names and their status.

methods.name: checkref
methods.description: Checks whether a referenced file or section exists in the documentation directories, reports broken references.

methods.name: scanmanpage
methods.description: Processes a man page file to detect formatting errors, section orderings, reference correctness, and specific formatting conventions.
